listenings.text: It was okay, I think. Revenue was good. The margin was not so good. Overhead was big, very big. In general it was a normal quarter, more or less.

Better than we expected. Revenue was one point four eight million, nine percent higher than last quarter, and ahead of forecast. The margin was twenty-two percent, three points lower than last year. The reason is overhead: it is the highest since twenty twenty-three.
